# Hermes NMI (Substrate Edition)

> **The synapse between thinking and doing, now with substrate cells.**

## What's new vs the original

| Original | Substrate Edition |
|---|---|
| Telemetry frames as opaque blobs | Telemetry frames as substrate cells |
| No chain | FNV-1a 64-bit prev_hash chain |
| `state_hash: [u8; 32]` | + `substrate_hash: u64` chain |

## The substrate pattern

Every telemetry frame can be wrapped as a substrate cell:

```rust
use hermes_nmi::{TelemetryFrame, SubstrateCell};

let frame = TelemetryFrame { /* ... */ };
let prev_hash = 0u64; // From previous cell
let cell = frame.as_substrate_cell(prev_hash);

println!("Cell: {}", cell.hash_hex());
```

## Quick Start

```rust
use hermes_nmi::{fnv1a_64, fnv1a_hex, verify_canary, SubstrateCell};

assert!(verify_canary());  // Fleet canary matches

let cell = SubstrateCell::new("telemetry-001", 0, "agent reports success");
println!("Hash: {}", cell.hash_hex());
```
